title.en: Twin powered Earth flybys turn ESCAPADE’s detour toward Mars
title.zh: 两次动力地球飞掠，让ESCAPADE绕行之路通向火星

summary.en: NASA reports completed departure maneuvers and Rocket Lab adds a November10engineering account; Mars capture and coordinated science remain ahead.
summary.zh: NASA报告出发机动已完成，Rocket Lab于11月10日补充工程说明；火星捕获与协同科学观测仍在前方。

title.en: Windows offers stronger NTLM signing before a later enforcement step
title.zh: Windows先默认提出NTLM签名，后续强制阶段仍待推进

summary.en: Microsoft’s November10updates start a phased integrity change: updated clients offer signing, while unsigned access remains accepted at current server defaults.
summary.zh: 微软11月10日更新开启分阶段完整性保护：更新客户端默认提出签名，服务器目前默认仍接受未签名连接。
